title: User Registration and Account Creation
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register and create an account.
testDescription: A new user provides valid information to register and create an account.
prerequisites: User must have access to a valid email address.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter valid user details including name, email, and password.
3. Agree to terms and conditions.
4. Click 'Register' button.
expectedResult: User receives a confirmation email and account is created successfully.
additionalFields: PII handling, data masking for sensitive fields

title: Product Search and Filtering
description: Verify that users can search for products and apply filters.
testDescription: A user searches for a product and applies filters to narrow down results.
prerequisites: Products must be available in the database.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the search bar.
2. Enter a product name or keyword.
3. Apply filters such as price range, category, and brand.
4. Click 'Search' button.
expectedResult: Relevant products are displayed according to the search criteria and filters applied.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for price filters

title: Shopping Cart Management
description: Verify that users can add, update, and remove items from the shopping cart.
testDescription: A user manages items in their shopping cart.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and products must be available.
stepsToPerform:
1. Add a product to the cart.
2. Update the quantity of the product.
3. Remove a product from the cart.
expectedResult: Cart is updated accordingly with correct item quantities and total price.
additionalFields: State Transition testing for cart status

title: Checkout Process and Payment Gateway Integration
description: Verify that users can complete the checkout process and make a payment.
testDescription: A user completes the checkout process using a valid payment method.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and a valid payment method.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Enter shipping details.
3. Select a payment method.
4. Complete the payment process.
expectedResult: Payment is processed successfully and an order confirmation is displayed.
additionalFields: High-risk edge cases in payment processing

title: Order Confirmation and Notification
description: Verify that users receive an order confirmation and notification after a successful purchase.
testDescription: A user receives confirmation and notification for their order.
prerequisites: User must have completed a purchase.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete a purchase.
2. Check for order confirmation on the website.
3. Verify receipt of email notification.
expectedResult: Order confirmation is displayed and email notification is received.
additionalFields: Data integrity checks for order details

title: User Profile Management
description: Verify that users can update their profile information.
testDescription: A user updates their profile details such as name, email, and password.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and have an existing profile.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the profile settings page.
2. Update profile details including name, email, and password.
3. Save changes.
expectedResult: Profile information is updated successfully and changes are reflected in the user account.
additionalFields: Data integrity checks for profile updates, PII handling

title: Role-based Access Control
description: Verify that users have appropriate access based on their roles.
testDescription: A user with a specific role attempts to access restricted areas.
prerequisites: User must be logged in with a defined role.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with a user account assigned a specific role.
2. Attempt to access various sections of the application.
3. Verify access permissions.
expectedResult: User can access permitted areas and is restricted from unauthorized sections.
additionalFields: Decision Table testing for role permissions

title: Data Validation and Error Handling
description: Verify that the system handles invalid inputs gracefully.
testDescription: A user enters invalid data in various fields across the application.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to different forms (e.g., registration, checkout).
2. Enter invalid data (e.g., incorrect email format, negative price).
3. Submit the form.
expectedResult: System displays appropriate error messages and prevents form submission.
additionalFields: Handling of invalid inputs, error messaging

title: Integration with External Systems
description: Verify integration with external payment processors.
testDescription: A user completes a transaction using an external payment gateway.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and a valid payment method.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Select an external payment gateway.
3. Complete the payment process.
expectedResult: Payment is processed successfully through the external gateway and order is confirmed.

title: UI Interactions Across All Screens
description: Verify consistent UI interactions and responsiveness across all screens.
testDescription: A user navigates through various screens and interacts with UI elements.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate through different pages (e.g., home, product, checkout).
2. Interact with UI elements (e.g., buttons, links, dropdowns).
3. Resize browser window to test responsiveness.
expectedResult: UI elements function correctly and the layout is responsive across different screen sizes.

title: Guest Checkout Process
description: Verify that users can complete the checkout process as a guest without creating an account.
testDescription: A user completes the checkout process as a guest using a valid payment method.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Select 'Checkout as Guest'.
3. Enter shipping details.
4. Select a payment method.
5. Complete the payment process.
expectedResult: Payment is processed successfully and an order confirmation is displayed.
additionalFields: Guest checkout, PII handling for guest users

title: Wishlist Management
description: Verify that users can add, view, and remove items from their wishlist.
testDescription: A user manages items in their wishlist.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to a product page.
2. Add the product to the wishlist.
3. View the wishlist.
4. Remove a product from the wishlist.
expectedResult: Wishlist is updated accordingly with correct items.
additionalFields: State Transition testing for wishlist status

title: Order History and Details
description: Verify that users can view their order history and details.
testDescription: A user views their past orders and order details.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and have completed at least one purchase.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the order history page.
2. Select an order to view details.
3. Verify order details such as items, total amount, and status.
expectedResult: Order history and details are displayed accurately.
additionalFields: Data integrity checks for order history

title: Password Recovery
description: Verify that users can recover their password using the password recovery feature.
testDescription: A user recovers their password using the password recovery process.
prerequisites: User must have an existing account.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the login page.
2. Click on 'Forgot Password'.
3. Enter registered email address.
4. Follow the instructions in the password recovery email.
expectedResult: User is able to reset their password and log in with the new password.

title: Multi-Currency Support
description: Verify that the system supports transactions in multiple currencies.
testDescription: A user selects a different currency and completes a purchase.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the currency selection option.
2. Select a different currency.
3. Proceed to checkout.
4. Complete the payment process.
expectedResult: Prices are displayed in the selected currency and payment is processed successfully.
additionalFields: Currency conversion, Boundary Value Analysis for currency fields
